onboardWelcomeDesc: All 150 Psalms in one beautiful app. Read, reflect, and grow in your faith journey.
onboardNotifDesc: Get a new psalm verse delivered to you every day. Enable notifications in Settings to build your daily rhythm.
onboardChallengesDesc: Follow guided plans like '40 Days of Testing' or 'Praise Journey'. Read psalms one day at a time with purpose.
onboardLibraryDesc: Bookmark verses, write notes, add highlights, and revisit your reading history — all in one place.
onboardBadgesDesc: Build a daily reading streak and unlock achievement badges. Track your progress with detailed reading stats.
onboardReadyDesc: Tap the ⌃ arrow in the bottom bar anytime to open Library, Stats, Badges, and Challenges.
notifScheduleFailedMessage: Your daily verse reminder could not be scheduled. Please try again.
psalmUnavailable: This psalm is not available in the selected translation. Try another translation from Settings.
backupUnavailable: Cloud backup is not available in this build. See the setup guide to enable it.
backupDisconnectBody: Psalms Way will stop backing up. Your existing backup stays in your Google Drive and your data on this device is untouched.
backupErrNotConfigured: Cloud backup is not available in this build.
backupErrAuthExpired: Google access has expired or was revoked. Reconnect your account to continue.
backupErrNetwork: No connection. Check your network and try again.
backupErrQuota: Google Drive is temporarily rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.
backupErrServer: Google Drive is unavailable right now. Try again later.
backupErrIncompatible: That backup was made by a newer version of Psalms Way. Update the app to restore it.
backupErrRestoreFailed: Couldn't combine your data. Nothing on this phone was changed.
backupErrUnknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

cloudIntro: Keep your bookmarks, notes, highlights, favourites, reading history, streak, badges and challenges safe in your own Google Drive. Sign in with the same account on a new phone to get them all back.
cloudPrivacy: Saved in a private app folder in your Google Drive. Only Psalms Way can see it; we never receive your data.
cloudAutoNote: Backs up automatically when you open the app.
cloudConnectDone: All set. Your data is backed up to your Google account.
cloudConnectDoneAdded: All set. Items added from your Google account: {{count}}.
cloudRetryLater: Psalms Way will try again next time you open the app.
cloudEmptyTitle: This phone has no saved data
cloudEmptyBody: Automatic backup is paused so your Google backup isn't replaced with nothing.
cloudGetDataBack: Get my data back from Google
cloudBackUpAnywayConfirm: This replaces your Google backup with this phone's empty data. Continue?
cloudRecoverDone: Your data is back on this phone.
backupErrDriveFull: Your Google Drive is full. Free up space in your Google account and backups will continue automatically.
backupErrPlayServices: Google Play services is needed for cloud backup. Install or update it from the Play Store, then try again.
cloudUnreadableKeptAside: An unreadable backup was found in your Google Drive on {{date}}. It was kept aside there, not deleted, and this phone's data was backed up normally.
cloudLocalUnreadableTitle: Some data on this phone couldn't be read
cloudLocalUnreadableBody: Automatic backup is paused so your Google backup isn't replaced with damaged data.
cloudBackUpAnywayUnreadableConfirm: This replaces your Google backup with what this phone can still read. Continue?
